desc: Ideation: model the operation as a complete ternary majority tree and derive the local DP rule.
Parse N and the binary string A robustly, handling both contiguous and whitespace-separated input forms.
Implement bottom-up level-by-level DP using compact arrays for cost-to-output-0 and cost-to-output-1.
Define leaf base costs: cost 0 to output the current bit and cost 1 to output the opposite bit.
Define the internal-node combination rule: cost to output value v is the sum of the two smallest child costs for v.
Track or infer the root’s current value and output the cost to force the root to the opposite value.
Verify correctness on the samples and edge cases such as N=1, all zeros, all ones, and maximum N=13.
